(2) PACKING TABLE physical/qwen_kv_slots/qfd_tt_ctlm_pack.json (22 bundles, LSB-first; posted in el1011-qwen-tp8.log), TP8 widths: c<b>[340:0] (343 in the contract: t_sel_e / t_tv_e are 13 b at G 3,072), lc<b>[25:0] (28), f<b>[103:0] (107: the 3 lane-fault bits have no body port; tr_fault is retired, tied 0 as in ot_qfd_spine_band). structural_change: vs 61 loop rows of ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_i (1 CLOSED fpbam-150a27450 at 475.2^2, M8 era; 9 setup + 2 hold early-fails; fpamh / pk hold stalls on I2R / R2O windows): (1) NEW top = slot cell qfd_tt_ctlm with the contract bundles on the v4b faces (band control W, VM words S, sequencer / up4 words N) instead of the old top / left / bottom / right regions; (2) TP8 body ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_i_fpm_tp8 (G 3,072): the G-sized buses halve (scale 24 groups, 6 argmax partials, 13-b selects), ~1.1k fewer pin flops; (3) layer cap M5 for signals and PG, pins M4 E/W + M5 N/S (was M4/M6 + M5/M7); (4) kit recipe 2: hold margin 30 ps, macro halo 5.4 um, pin hold cells on every data input and output (the I2R / R2O hold windows that stalled fpbamh2 / fpapk / fpbpk), every port flop FIRM at its pin.

job.purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 slot cell qfd_tt_ctlm (1 instance tt_ctlm): first view under the die master name. Body = ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_i_fpm_tp8 (ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_i PSRAM 1 / HQ2 1 / MEREG 3 / RRG 1 / PCUT 1 / AUD 33975 at G 3,072; TP4 body closed as qfd_tt_ctlm_i-fpbam-150a27450 at 475.2^2); the wrapper is WIRING ONLY (generated from the packing table): body ports are pin flops (AUD die-input pin flops, kept output stations). 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_64x512 (program store) + 4 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256 (tag delays). Cut: 2,351 pin bits on 4 faces of 475 um (W 1,410 b on M4 = 0.14 of the 9,900 W-face M2/M4 tracks); widest internal cut = the 1,024-b program word, < 0.10 of any 475-um cut on M2-M5. Clock: sinks per root measured by the --cts gate (gate_result.json).
